# Learned instinct: ansible-winrm-no-basic-auth (confidence 1)

WinRM connections to Windows targets must use `kerberos` or `ntlm` transport. `ansible_winrm_transport: basic` sends credentials in base64 (not encrypted) and is never acceptable in production. `ansible_winrm_server_cert_validation` must be `validate`, not `ignore`.

Source: PCI DSS v4.0.1 Req 4.2.1; CIS Windows Benchmark
